spec.scene: A patch of pale tan beach sand, wet and shining at the front edge, with a low sandy bank and a slice of dune grass at the back edge. At the center stands a lopsided sandcastle ringed by a dug moat, a dark green seaweed flag on a stick at its top, a little larger than life. A small boy in a red t-shirt kneels at its right, patting sand; a yellow bucket and blue spade lie front-left. Warm golden light washes the sand, casting long soft shadows.
spec.title: Sandcastle at Ocean Beach
spec.caption: We built a castle with a seaweed flag and a moat, just me and my brother.
